conviction_note: Nothing decisive and unpriced: two small inferences put reported ARR growth a little above the 10-11% broker bar (SEK translation and an easy Q3-25 comparison), offset by the company's own July warning on order intake. The findings sum to +0.9 and the scaled number is +0.45 (abs 7.5 x p_up 53); the scaled number is smaller because the sign is near a coin flip after a +18.8% 60-day run-up to the brokers' targets. The size is set by new numbers on a thin name whose ARR line has moved it +17.9% and -21.6% on results days.

findings.finding: SEK weakened through Q3 2026: September-average EUR/SEK was 11.24 against 10.96 in June and 11.00 in September 2025; NOK/SEK was 1.040 against 0.992 and 0.942. About 31% of revenue is outside Sweden (Q2: 64.6 of 205.3 MSEK), so translation adds roughly +1pt to reported y/y ARR growth over constant currency, and about +3-4 MSEK sequentially. That pushes reported ARR toward the top of the 10-11% bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: ARR growth is the line this stock trades on. Q3-25 ARR +13%: stock +17.9% on 2025-10-21. Q4-25 ARR +7% (10% at constant currency): -21.6% on 2026-02-12. Q1-26 +9%: -2.4%. Q2-26 +10%: +5.5%. Moves are from the Yahoo tape on the issuer's release dates.
findings.why_not_priced: Brokers state ARR growth without saying which FX basis they use. Pareto's 10% looks like Q2's constant-currency 10% rolled forward. If the market had priced a translation lift, the previews would quote ARR above 11%, or Q4 estimates would show more than one upward revision. The Q4 EPS trend rose 2.52 to 2.59 only in the last 7 days, on one revision.
findings.independence: Same direction as the base-effect finding, but from a different source (company ARR history, not FX data): https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=be6b6570da9257788eb9d1c2ef1a7f8a7&lang=en&src=listed

findings.finding: The y/y ARR comparison is easy. Q3-25 added only +9.1 MSEK sequentially (501.7 to 510.8), while Q1-26 added +17.3 (519.1 to 536.4) and Q2-26 +15.8 (to 552.2). If Q3-26 adds even ~+15, ARR is ~567 MSEK, +11.0% y/y, against Pareto's 10%; at the 2025 run-rate (+9) it is still ~10%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Same line as above. Large moves on ARR acceleration and deceleration (+17.9%, -21.6%); a ~1pt ARR improvement in Q2-26 came with +5.5%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: SB1 already models 11%. Pareto's 10% implies a sequential add of only ~+10 MSEK, below both 2026 quarters. If fully priced, both brokers would sit at 11% or higher. Sized small because the arithmetic is available to everyone and Q3 is the summer quarter.
findings.independence: Q1-26 and Q4-25 ARR figures from separate releases: https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b0b0d136351168fa8f35b4b343774b480&lang=en&src=listed

findings.finding: In the Q2 report the CEO warned of 'a degree of return to more cautious customer behaviour, with postponed decisions and longer sales cycles affecting order intake'. Q3 holds the summer, when net new ARR has been weakest, so new-sales and ARR adds could slow and the commentary could turn cautious.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Demand commentary went with the -21.6% Q4-25 day (ARR decelerating to 7%). In Q2-26 the same caution was published alongside a beat and the stock rose 5.5%, so the market looked through it once.
findings.why_not_priced: Public since July, but the stock has since rallied ~28% from 200 to 256 SEK, re-rating with sector multiples per Pareto. The price is not holding a slowdown. If it were, the run-up would have stalled and the previews would have trimmed ARR below 10%; instead SB1 sits at 11%.
findings.independence: Q1-26 CEO letter: 'we see neither dramatic headwinds nor growth optimism amongst our customers', https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b0b0d136351168fa8f35b4b343774b480&lang=en&src=listed

findings.finding: Redeye's Q3 preview (2026-10-05) names Lime Go Agentic as 'the company's first fully AI-native product, marking the first tangible AI revenue for the group'. Redeye kept its forecasts and its SEK354 base case. The release is likely to give the first AI revenue figures, which is a narrative positive in a sector trading on an 'AI squeeze'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print on this line. Redeye titled its Q4-25 review 'solid fundamentals despite AI squeeze' (that print fell 21.6%), and Swedish software names have traded on AI and US-sector headlines (Börskollen, Sep 2026).
findings.why_not_priced: Redeye made no change to its numbers, so no estimate holds AI revenue. The amount is likely immaterial to Q3 figures, so sized small: it moves sentiment, not the bar.

baseline_tension: The findings lean slightly positive and agree with neither the small negative priced lean (-0.20, run-up only) nor against it materially; the +18.8% 60-day run-up to near Pareto's 275 target argues for selling a modest beat, which is why p_up stays at 53.
language_note: Swedish Finwire/Börskollen copy carried the only stated Q3 bar. Pareto (2026-09-21): 'Inför tredje kvartalet räknar Pareto med 9 procent organisk tillväxt och att ebita-marginalen ökar till 25,5 procent. ARR väntas växa 10 procent' ('For the third quarter Pareto expects 9% organic growth and EBITA margin rising to 25.5%. ARR is expected to grow 10%'). SB1 (2026-09-29): 'räknar analyshuset med 11 procents ARR-tillväxt och 10 procents ökning i justerad ebita, i linje med Bloomberg-konsensus' ('the broker expects 11% ARR growth and a 10% rise in adjusted EBITA, in line with Bloomberg consensus'). English search returned only Redeye's headline.
The Swedish-language FI insider and short registers confirm no insider trades since June and no disclosed short; no English source carries this.
Issuer filings are bilingual (sv/en) and the Swedish versions added nothing.
lessons_applied: 'Too small about the move / tail intact / 3-7 analyst band': abs_move_pct raised 7.0 -> 7.5. The numbers are new (no pre-release), turnover is thin ($0.5m/day) and observed results-day moves include +17.9% and -21.6%.
'Understatement is the systematic error', applied to the one finding that is not simple arithmetic: FX translation raised +0.5 -> +0.7. It lands on ARR, the line that has moved this stock most.

'Reaction history moves p_up, not size' and 'verified fact is not a predicted reaction': p_up held at 53 because of the run-up to the broker targets; no change to the base-effect, order-intake or AI findings.
